purpose: Source-only diagnostic checklist frozen before acquisition of article3; some rows group values sharing one statistical population. Not question-derived labels or a statistical holdout.

source.title: Christmas Day preview: 49ers, Ravens square off in potential Super Bowl sneak peek
source.author: Colum Dell, Yardbarker

review_rules: Preserve players, teams, roles, opponents and competition as graph identities.
Keep per-game rates separate from totals; keep season, last-three, five-start, since-2019 and attendance-selected populations distinct.
Preview predictions are not realized outcomes. No invented actual score or current-season update.
Retain named odds provider and signed American odds without treating them as probabilities.
